name: YouTube Playlist
strategic_objective: Organize videos into structured collections that drive binge-watching, topic depth, and evergreen discoverability.

tone: Clear, organized, and outcome-focused. More like a course index or resource library than a promo.
copywriting_rules: The playlist title should clearly state the topic, use case, or series name. The description should explain what the viewer will get by watching the playlist in order, who it is for, and whether there is a recommended starting point.

Title: topic or series name with clear outcome. Description line 1–2: what the playlist covers and for whom. Body: recommended viewing order notes, links to key videos, or extra resources. Final lines: CTA to save the playlist.
Hashtags are secondary for playlists; clear titles and metadata matter more.
Mention collaborators or featured channels if the playlist includes their content.

required_generation_elements: Playlist title with clear topic or outcome
Description that explains what the playlist is for
CTA to save or bookmark the playlist
hard_constraints: Vague playlist titles like Misc or Other
Mixing unrelated topics into one playlist
No description or explanation of the playlist’s purpose
Random ordering that confuses first-time viewers
